name: GeoJSON Demo Source
shortDescription: Write a small GeoJSON of Bengaluru places (points, areas, a road) — a source for trying the map view
description: Writes one GeoJSON FeatureCollection with a few sample Bengaluru features: landmark points, two park polygons and a road line. Needs no upstream input and no uploaded files. Use it to try the map: open the run and press Map on the output file.
